rationale: Edge-case and acceptance lenses (compact profile) ran with parseable output and produced zero findings; all seven acceptance criteria pass, with test-suite/lint/build execution left to Stage 7. 0 deferred, 0 dismissed; standards audit not expected for this profile.

business_review.item: AC1: 502/503/504 retried on CQL search and restrictions call; no regression on existing search tests
business_review.notes: Both methods share _confluence_retry with the unchanged HTTPError branch of _is_transient_error.

business_review.item: AC2: transient requests ConnectionError retried on both call sites
business_review.notes: _is_transient_error true for non-SSL ConnectionError; is_public_page and _search_content_by_cql both decorated; tests cover both.

business_review.item: AC3: RemoteDisconnected wrapped in ProtocolError as ConnectionError uses configured attempt limit and backoff
business_review.notes: Shared decorator uses STORAGE_CONFIG stop and wait; tests assert call_count == indexing_max_retries.

business_review.item: AC4: after a successful retry, indexing continues with remaining pages
business_review.notes: test_lazy_load_continues_after_restrictions_retry covers 3 pages with a mid-page ConnectionError.

business_review.item: AC5: on exhaustion, log and error text contain exception class and retry-exhaustion context
business_review.notes: ConfluenceRetryExhaustedError str and ERROR log include class, HTTP status, attempts and 'retries exhausted'; cause chained.

business_review.item: AC6: tests added with tenacity.nap.time.sleep patched and include_restricted_content=False
business_review.notes: Restrictions and CQL retry, exhaustion and continuation tests present; existing 502/503/504 tests retained.

business_review.item: AC7: 401/403 and SSLError not retried on either call site, each with a test
business_review.notes: Parametrized tests assert a single call and no sleep on CQL and restrictions.

business_review.item: Full test suite, lint and build execution
business_review.notes: Requires running pytest and ruff; not verifiable from the diff.
